title: Translations that arrive with the route
lead: Nothing here is loaded up front. The shell strings ship with the config, and each page's namespace has its own loader that runs the first time you open that route.

locale.title: Locale negotiation
locale.text: The server reads a cookie, then Accept-Language, then falls back to the default.

route.title: One namespace per route
route.text: Opening /about runs the about loader. Coming back runs nothing — a loader fires once per freshness window.

ssr.title: One instance per request
ssr.text: The server builds its own instance and hands the result to the browser, so no visitor sees another's language.
